automations.name: Vehicle matcher
automations.does: Re-ranks vehicle / trim / package matches with VIN availability, price build and talk tracks for the customer in front of you.

automations.name: Objection coach
automations.does: Listens to the floor conversation, classifies objections and drafts a suggested response with its success rate.

automations.name: Next best action
automations.does: Keeps the one-click next step current — book test drive, send finance link, schedule follow-up — from the journey state machine.

automations.name: Trade equity watch
automations.does: Recomputes the customer's trade equity and payment delta and flags upgrade timing on the journey.

automations.name: Follow-up drafter
automations.does: Drafts the personalized follow-up message for this journey and sends it through the customer's preferred channel.

automations.name: First-response drafter
automations.does: Drafts a cited first response (incentive bulletins, inventory, CRM history) for each inbound lead inside its SLA.

automations.name: Shift call list
automations.does: Publishes the prioritized call list for the shift to Tasks, ordered by SLA and close probability.

automations.name: Appointment booker
automations.does: Books the test-drive or visit appointment and sends the confirmation through the outreach channel.

automations.name: Predictive part watch
automations.does: Watches mileage, wear curves and service history to predict part failures — raising a Lead Desk lead and a customer offer before the part fails.

automations.name: Lead router
automations.does: Hands the lead to a floor advisor as an explicit ownership handoff with a Task for the receiver.

automations.name: Deal structurer
automations.does: Builds term / rate / payment scenarios across lender offers from the worksheet (structure_deal, auditable math).

automations.name: Menu attach recommender
automations.does: Scores GAP / VSC / tire & wheel / prepaid maintenance / charger attach likelihood for this customer and vehicle.

automations.name: Lender decision chaser
automations.does: Tracks pending lender decisions and nudges or escalates when a decision stalls past its expected turnaround.

automations.name: Compliance sentry
automations.does: Checks TILA / Reg Z disclosures, state doc-fee caps and adverse-action requirements before the deal can advance.

automations.name: Morning dispatch
automations.does: Dispatches today's ROs to technicians, stages parts and writes the tech briefs before the lane opens.

automations.name: Estimate builder
automations.does: Turns inspection findings into a sourced estimate — procedures, labor times, parts and coverage — with source_ref on every number.

automations.name: Approval chaser
automations.does: Re-presents pending estimates and reminds the customer (or you) when a decision stalls.

automations.name: Promise re-forecaster
automations.does: Re-forecasts promised times from parts ETAs and line status and flags at-risk ROs on the board.

automations.name: Declined-work follow-up
automations.does: Follows up declined work on its cadence with a one-tap booking link for the customer.

automations.name: Predictive part watch
automations.does: Watches mileage, wear curves and service history to predict part failures — raising a Lead Desk lead and a customer offer before the part fails.

automations.name: Repurchase handoff
automations.does: Spots equity-positive vehicles in the lane and hands them to sales as a DISCOVER journey (source=service_lane).

automations.name: DTC diagnoser
automations.does: Looks up the code's description, likely causes and cited TSBs from the indexed repair knowledge.

automations.name: Draft-line builder
automations.does: Pulls the repair procedure, labor time and parts for the selected cause into a draft estimate line.

automations.name: Evidence checker
automations.does: Blocks yellow / red MPI items from submission until photo, video or voice evidence is attached.

automations.name: Parts ETA tracker
automations.does: Tracks every open order's ETA against the RO's promised time and flags the ones that put promises at risk.

automations.name: Supersession finder
automations.does: Finds superseding part numbers for back-ordered parts so the RO can keep moving.

automations.name: Repair resumer
automations.does: Releases the held RO back into REPAIR and notifies the advisor the moment parts arrive.

automations.name: Cockpit insight
automations.does: Writes the sourced [AI INSIGHT] on the Service Cockpit from the same fixed-ops read models you see.

automations.name: Goodwill triage
automations.does: Packages goodwill requests with history, coverage and margin context into your Approvals queue.

automations.name: Threshold what-if
automations.does: Recomputes repair-vs-replace and labor-rate what-ifs over current lane data (Code Interpreter, auditable).

automations.name: Demand scorer
automations.does: Re-scores every VIN against active journey shortlists so aging stock and hot models surface in the grid.

automations.name: Disposition recommender
automations.does: Recommends keep-for-CPO vs wholesale vs auction with reasoning from comps, age and demand.

automations.name: Acquisition scout
automations.does: Spots equity-positive, high-demand vehicles in the service drive as used-inventory acquisition targets.

automations.name: Reschedule notifier
automations.does: Notifies the customer of delivery changes through their preferred channel and updates appointments.

automations.name: Delivery-day messenger
automations.does: Sends the delivery-day message with checklist, documents status and arrival details.

automations.name: Post-delivery survey
automations.does: Moves the journey DELIVER → OWN and sends the post-delivery survey automatically.

automations.name: Store insight digest
automations.does: Writes the per-tab [AI INSIGHT] cards on the Store Cockpit from the store's own read models.

automations.name: Stalled-journey nudger
automations.does: Finds journeys stalled past their stage SLA and nudges the owning advisor with a Task.

automations.name: Fixed-ops watch
automations.does: Flags promised-time risk, parts holds and estimate-approval delays into the Service tab and Alerts.

oem_marketing.title: Campaign agents (AgentCore step — dashboards stay in Quick)

automations.name: Budget-shift drafter
automations.does: Attributes spend to delivered vehicles and drafts budget-shift recommendations into the finance Approvals queue.

automations.name: Audience refresher
automations.does: Refreshes Personalize segments from the latest journey events and stages ad-platform exports.

automations.name: Nurture executor
automations.does: Executes your published nurture policy — cadence caps, quiet hours, stop conditions — across every journey without redeploy.

automations.name: Policy previewer
automations.does: Renders a draft policy or template against a seeded customer so you see exactly what the Journey Agent would send.

automations.name: Consent guard
automations.does: Enforces per-state consent rules and customer quiet hours on every outbound touch.

customer.title: Working for you behind the scenes

automations.name: Build re-scorer
automations.does: Re-scores your saved builds whenever inventory or incentives change, so prices and matches stay current.

automations.name: Journey guide
automations.does: Keeps your next steps current and passes you to a person at the dealership whenever you ask.

automations.name: Service concierge
automations.does: Tracks your repair live, explains each finding in plain language, and keeps your promised time honest.
